watches.name: BONEST GATTI BG9014 Carbon Fiber Skeleton Chronograph Watch
watches.description: Carbon Fiber Engineering, Mechanical Character The BONEST GATTI BG9014 pairs a lightweight carbon fiber case and bracelet with an open-worked automatic mechanical chronograph. Its sapphire crystal, luminous hands and markers, and sculpted round profile create a bold sport-luxury watch for daily wear. Automatic mechanical chronograph: skeleton display with chronograph seconds, minutes, and hours Full carbon fiber construction: carbon fiber case and matching bracelet Sapphire crystal: clear, scratch-resistant dial protection Luminous display: luminous hands and hour markers for low-light readability 3ATM water resistance: designed for everyday splash resistance Specifications Model: BG9014 Movement: Automatic mechanical chronograph Crystal: Sapphire crystal Case material: Carbon fiber Dial Shape: Round Bracelet material: Carbon fiber Case dimensions: 41 mm wide × 13 mm thick Bracelet width: 20 mm Water resistance: 3ATM Variants: Silver Vein (BG9014-C1); Obsidian Gold (BG9014-C2) Package Contents 1 × BONEST GATTI BG9014 watch. Care and Use Keep the crown fully secured before exposure to water. Do not operate the crown or chronograph pushers underwater. Rinse away salt or chemicals with fresh water and dry with a soft cloth. Water resistance is not permanent and should be checked periodically. After-Sales Support For warranty, returns, sizing, or product-use questions, contact BONEST GATTI customer support with your order number.
